author: YASHASVI VASISTHA
description: India's overall trade deficit narrowed to $9.41 billion in August 2026. Exports grew 25.41% year-on-year to $82.68 billion, while imports rose to $92.09 billion. Merchandise exports increased 26.12% to $43.81 billion, showing strong performance. Services exports also registered robust growth, contributing to the positive trend. This export momentum accelerated further, indicating a positive trade outlook.
title: India’s exports jump 25.4% in August, narrowing overall trade deficit to $9.41bn

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: A horror enthusiast recounted her bizarre overnight adventure at the infamous Conjuring House, a nearly 300-year-old farmhouse in Rhode Island that inspired the renowned film series. She described the atmosphere as unsettling and 'sickening,' creating an intense discomfort for anyone inside. With a notorious history of paranormal events, the location fascinates thrill-seekers, though it is currently closed for repairs and public access.

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: Palantir, Nvidia and Booz Allen Hamilton are restricting how employees use Anthropic and OpenAI's advanced AI models, and want guarantees that proprietary company data will not be retained or used for training. The trigger is Anthropic's 30-day data retention policy, introduced in June with Claude Fable 5. Palantir is holding out for irrevocable zero data retention, Nvidia is routing sensitive work to its own Nemotron models, and Anthropic has answered with Enterprise Frontier Safeguards.

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: A nearly 2,000-acre former farm along Wisconsin’s Sugar River is now permanently protected after years of drainage efforts and a tax dispute. Groundswell Conservancy and Ducks Unlimited bought the property, which includes wetlands, floodplain forests and prairies. The land will become part of the Avon Bottoms Wildlife Area and remain open for hiking, fishing, hunting and wildlife watching.
title: Wisconsin family’s 2,000 floodplain acres now permanently protected

description: Actor Josh Duhamel has acquired a tranquil property in Minnesota, initially featuring just an old cabin. Over the years, he expanded the land to fifty-two acres, modernizing it with essential utilities like electricity and running water. This transformation has provided a beloved retreat for his family, where they can enjoy a range of outdoor activities, including leisure time by the lakeside with his son.

These efforts signal a coordinated push for indigenous unmanned systems development.

description: During a conversation with Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, Donald Trump dismissed concerns over AI doomerism as a hoax. He emphasized that robots won't dominate humanity and urged against slowing down AI progress. Huang expressed recognition of AI safety worries but criticized the unscientific framing of existential risks, affirming that responsible AI innovation can coexist with substantial advancements.

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: In a bold stand for their land and legacy, Texas landowners and conservationists are taking legal action against the Trump administration's border wall efforts. They emphasize that the Big Bend area, known for its natural beauty, has minimal illegal crossing incidents. The lawsuit contests the rationale behind sidelining environmental protections and raises alarms about potential harm to both private properties and local ecosystems.

description: On September 14, 1901, Theodore Roosevelt became US president in the library of Ansley Wilcox’s Buffalo home after William McKinley died. For the 125th anniversary, the Theodore Roosevelt Inaugural Site recreate the ceremony in the same room. Actor Joe Wiegand portray Roosevelt, arriving in Buffalo by train before taking the 35-word presidential oath.

description: Tanks have undergone significant transformation, evolving from basic trench-crossing vehicles to critical components of combined-arms warfare. In World War Two, they became the backbone of armored formations, while Cold War innovations led to the development of main battle tanks for vast combat scenarios. Today, amidst modern warfare complexities involving drones and precision anti-tank weaponry, tanks are utilized effectively at smaller unit levels, providing essential firepower and infantry support.

description: Bhuvneshwar Kumar's impressive IPL seasons have reignited discussions about his potential return to the Indian team. He admitted feeling deserving of another opportunity while stressing it is not his sole motivation. The veteran pacer has accepted his current omission from the national squad. Bhuvneshwar sensed his 2022 World Cup career might have concluded after the semifinal loss.

description: Microsoft has unveiled its Humanist AI Code of Conduct to gather public insight. This framework delineates definitive prohibitions for its proprietary AI models, focusing on actions related to weaponization, cyberattacks, and maintaining human oversight. The objective is to guarantee AI development is aligned with human values, especially in light of concerning behaviors observed in competing AI systems.

These incidents expose serious vulnerabilities in the pharmaceutical supply chain, revealing diverted cancer treatments originating from government hospitals. The issue encompasses more than just manufacturing flaws; it concerns the entire journey of drugs from suppliers to patients. Employing robust technology and verification processes is essential to curtail future instances of fake-drug rackets.

description: The Karnataka high court reduced a woman's alimony from Rs 2 crore to Rs 50 lakh.  It upheld the divorce, citing cruelty and marital breakdown between the couple. Amodei emphasizes choosing the right development paths for AI safety.

description: Sethuraman Panchanathan, an Indian American engineer and former NSF director, has been named the 2026 recipient of the National Academy of Engineering’s Arthur M. Bueche Award. A revolutionary new transport system has eliminated the previous risky three-hour journey along the cliffs. With the introduction of two elevators and a cable car, the village is seamlessly connected to the school. This modernization has not only made education accessible but has also sparked a boost in local tourism and economic growth.

A complainant alleged the banner insulted Hindu religious sentiments. Police initiated an inquiry and made the arrest under relevant law. The shop owner was taken into custody following the complaint.

description: Brendon McCullum has revealed that the decision to bring back Kevin Pietersen as a mentor was entirely his initiative. Joining the England coaching staff for the upcoming white-ball matches, Pietersen’s past criticisms haven’t deterred McCullum. The oversight framework fails to secure buyer possession effectively, raising concerns about the effectiveness of the system.

Police are currently investigating the exact cause of the explosion and the ensuing blaze.

The settlement resolves allegations of false compliance certifications from 2017 to the present.

He emphasized Sooryavanshi's remarkable performance against Zimbabwe, where he was named Player of the Series, and criticized the team management for not giving him a fair opportunity. author: TIMESOFINDIA.COM
description: In a remarkable achievement, Indian-origin nurse Agimol Pradeep has clinched the Aster Guardians Global Nursing Award 2026, celebrated for her impactful advocacy in organ and stem-cell donation. The $250,000 award will see half allocated to Upahaar's efforts in expanding organ donation initiatives. This recognition not only emphasizes the vital contributions of nurses to healthcare but also aligns with Kerala's efforts to bolster its nursing workforce amid persistent global shortages.
title: Meet Agimol Pradeep, Indian-origin nurse who won $250,000 global nursing award

author: TOI ENTERTAINMENT DESK
description: Celebrating exemplary achievements in television, the 78th Primetime Emmy Awards of 2026 showcased winners like 'The Diplomat' and 'Widow's Bay.' Drama actors Noah Wyle and Rhea Seehorn were awarded for their performances, while Matthew Rhys and Jean Smart took honors in comedy. Additionally, 'DTF St. Louis' and 'The Muppet Show' garnered accolades, reflecting a diverse range of talent and creativity in the entertainment landscape.
title: Emmys 2026 winners: 'Widow's Bay' to 'The Pitt'; shows and stars who took the trophy

title: Oil price today: Brent crude rises as Saudi pipeline outage raise supply concerns

author: SHREEDHAR RATHI
description: Karnataka Chief Minister DK Shivakumar stated Donald Trump is copying Congress's guarantee schemes. He described these welfare programs as a blockbuster success among the people. Trump recently proposed giving every adult American $5,000 if Republicans win. This proposal could cost approximately $1.2 trillion based on current estimates. Details on financing and congressional approval for Trump's plan remain unclear.
title: 'Trump is copying us': Shivakumar says US $5,000 plan 'inspired' by Congress

author: PRANAV SHUKLA
description: Michael Holding, the former cricketer, has voiced support for improved treatment of Imran Khan, advocating that the former captain deserves humane conditions. With rising worries over Khan's health and the adequacy of prison facilities, international cricket figures have previously reached out to the Prime Minister of Pakistan. Holding’s emotions reflect a broader sentiment regarding the plight of the former leader in confinement.
title: ‘You don’t treat human beings that way’: Holding slams Pakistan over Imran Khan

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: Meta's AI division initiated a program to gather employee computer data for training their models. This led to employee backlash due to fears over privacy compromises and potential job displacements. Shortly after, a major data breach occurred, revealing private communications and sensitive details. Within hours, Meta halted the contentious program, leaving the future use of the gathered data for AI development ambiguous.
title: Meta needed employee data for AI edge, but faced a very 'human problem'

author: ARYAN SINGH
description: Debris believed to be a Chinese-made DF-15A ballistic missile booster was found in Yemen. Open-source analysts identified the component and attributed it to Saudi Arabia's military. This discovery occurs amid intensified fighting and increased missile attacks in the region. The DF-15A is a solid-fuelled short-range ballistic missile with a significant range. Saudi Arabia has not officially confirmed operating this specific Chinese missile system.
title: Mystery missile in Yemen: Did Saudi Arabia use China-made DF-15A?

title: ‘Serious lapse’: Air India CEO summoned after 3 foreigners 'skip' immigration check

author: TOI ENTERTAINMENT DESK
description: In a delightful video shared by Tamil Nadu Chief Minister Vijay, fans are treated to a behind-the-scenes look at his visit to the Silverstone racing circuit. The footage showcases his meeting with actor and professional racer Ajith Kumar, who can be seen enjoying a thrilling race car experience and posing proudly with the Indian flag.
title: Vijay-Ajith’s Silverstone moment goes viral as CM shares a special video

author: VRITI JAIN
description: Woman biker Sia shared a video statement refuting claims of an accidental collision.  She stated the footage showed the car chasing bikers before the incident occurred.  The accused driver denied deliberately hitting Sia and claimed the videos were edited.  Gurgaon Police registered an FIR and are investigating the viral footage further.  The incident highlights concerns about road safety for women in the region.
title: 'I could've died': Gurgaon biker rebuts driver's 'accident' defence in new video

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: Salesforce has announced twenty-seven million dollars in new education grants nationwide.  Eighteen million dollars will directly support public school districts in five major cities.  This funding builds on fourteen years of partnership and a growing commitment to education.  The company is expanding its 1-1-1 philanthropic model into schools through a relaunched Adopt-a-School program.  Salesforce aims to make an incredible impact by combining financial resources, technology, and employee expertise.
title: Marc Benioff’s $2.7 mn school donation came with a rule: No hate, no discrimination

author: SHUBHANSHU DWIVEDI
description: India beat Sri Lanka by 72 runs in the Asia Cup final in Dubai on Sunday, but the team did not accept the trophy from Naqvi. It was the second year in a row that an Indian team skipped receiving the Asia Cup trophy from the ACC chairman, after the men's team did the same during the 2025 Asia Cup following the Pahalgam terror attack.
title: Mohsin Naqvi 'didn't object' to India refusing Asia Cup trophy from him, says BCCI

author: TOI REAL ESTATE DESK
description: A Woodland Hills home in Los Angeles that has hosted 173 productions since 2021 is now on the market for $3.245 million. The 4,675-sq-ft property has earned more than $1.5 million from filming. The sale also includes the established Rum Punch House filming business, industry contacts, website and production-related infrastructure.
title: LA home earned $1.5 million from filming; now it is for sale for $3.245 million

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: At the age of 84, Nan Barb is a remarkable woman who travels over two thousand kilometers each month. She dedicates her time to delivering donated clothing from her op shop to remote communities throughout Western Australia. Her efforts bridge the gap for those in isolated areas who require essential goods, and the community is actively fundraising to secure a larger truck to enhance her vital mission.
title: At 84, Nan Barb drives 2,000km a month delivering clothes across Australia

author: TOI ENTERTAINMENT DESK
description: Mirzapur The Movie has amassed a remarkable Rs 273.64 crore in global earnings after its second week. However, the film saw a notable decline in collections on its eleventh day, with domestic earnings in India standing at Rs 190.20 crore. Overseas contributions added Rs 47.00 crore, while the overall occupancy rate for the eleventh day hit 26.82 percent.
title: 'Mirzapur The Movie' misses Rs 275 crore mark by a whisker

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Abbott has agreed to pay nearly $385 million to resolve alleged false claims involving infant formula made at its Michigan facility. The settlement follows the company’s 2022 recall and plant closure amid contamination concerns. Abbott maintains that no distributed infant formula tested positive for Cronobacter and says government testing found no bacteria in unopened products.
title: Abbott to pay $385M to settle US claims over infant formula plant

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Prince Harry and Meghan Markle have withdrawn Archie and Lilibet from their new UK school after just two days, citing security concerns around the school run. The Sussex children, who recently returned to Britain with their parents, are expected to move to another school in the area. Their security arrangements are also under review.
title: Harry and Meghan pull Archie and Lilibet from UK school over security concerns

author: PRANAV SHUKLA
description: Sunil Gavaskar has put forth a suggestion to enhance the BCCI's Cricket Advisory Committee by expanding its scope. He proposes that legendary former cricketers be included to ensure diverse perspectives. This broader committee could effectively tackle challenges related to both domestic and international cricket scheduling. Moreover, involving icons like Sachin Tendulkar would considerably elevate the credibility of the discussions. Gavaskar further insists on implementing a similar framework for women's cricket.
title: Gavaskar urges BCCI to make big change, names Sachin, Dravid for key role

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: In a forecast that raises concerns, Dell Technologies CEO Michael Dell has warned of an escalating semiconductor shortage that could persist through 2026 and into 2027. As artificial intelligence technology rapidly advances, the manufacturing sector struggles to keep pace, creating significant and lasting supply issues. Customers are often willing to pay higher prices for essential hardware, as businesses recognize the crucial role AI plays in driving efficiency and innovation.
title: Michael Dell: Customers go through ‘five stages of grief’ after price hikes

author: NIKHIL SHARMA
description: A young woman fell from her superbike after a car allegedly cut her path. She narrowly escaped being run over by fast-moving traffic on Golf Course Road. Action camera footage captured the incident and its immediate aftermath. The driver of the Maruti Ciaz offered a different account of the events. The woman later shared the footage on social media platforms.
title: 'He said stop bike': Gurgaon woman biker recounts moments before car hits her

author: ARYAN SINGH
description: A recent Pentagon report highlights the extensive destruction of US military and diplomatic infrastructures due to Iranian strikes. Hundreds of buildings sustained damage across the Middle East, creating severe logistical hurdles and personnel displacements for American forces. The Iranian onslaught resulted in an estimated $184 million in damages to diplomatic establishments, escalating the conflict that ignited on February 28 in response to US and Israeli military actions.
title: From Bahrain to Riyadh: How Iran strikes battered US bases, embassies

author: VINEET RAMAKRISHNAN
description: Animesh Kujur arrives in Aichi-Nagoya with a 10.14 personal best in the 100m and the national 200m record of 20.32. He has gained confidence from international competitions, learned how to manage his body, when to peak and when to reduce the load. With strong Asian competition ahead, including Japan's Shuhei Tada and Soshi Mizukubo, Kujur believes his Asian Championships mistakes will not be repeated and is targeting medals in all three events.
title: 'The mistakes I made, I won't make again': Animesh Kujur ready for Asian Games

author: PRANAV SHUKLA
description: The celebration of India's Women's Asia Cup triumph was overshadowed when the team rejected the trophy presented by ACC president Mohsin Naqvi. This decision recalls a similar controversy during the men's Asia Cup final. Mohammad Kaif has voiced doubts regarding Naqvi's involvement in both political and sports spheres, reflecting wider issues related to his dual authority in the cricketing community.
title: 'Are they living in the past?': Ex-India cricketer slams Mohsin Naqvi

author: ARVIND CHAUHAN
description: Jeetendra Mishra, the newly appointed CEO, passionately defended his extensive experience in temple administration, highlighting his management of over fifty religious sites throughout his Air Force career. He emphasized that caring for temples is not just a responsibility but a profound duty. Mishra also shared his memorable visits to prominent pilgrimage centers across India, underscoring his commitment to this spiritual role.
title: Temple care is matter of duty for me, not publicity: Ram Mandir CEO Jeetendra Mishra

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Once a bustling mining site, Dalhalla is now a stunning open-air concert venue nestled in an abandoned Swedish quarry. Renowned for its outstanding natural acoustics discovered in 1991, this breathtaking locale invites performers and audiences alike to bask in the unique ambiance created by limestone walls shaped by an ancient meteorite impact. Annually, it enchants over 100,000 visitors, adding to the charm of the Dalarna region.
title: Swedish quarry turned opera venue draws 100K visitors each summer

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Cleveland’s near-East Side lost most of its population, falling from nearly 100,000 residents in the 1960s to fewer than 20,000 today. The city now plans 200 new homes through its Housing Innovation District, backed by $2 million in state funding. A tax increment financing plan could generate up to $182 million over 30 years for streets, sewers, parks and other improvements.
title: Cleveland district lost 80,000 residents; new plan aims to build 200 homes

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: What started as a simple backyard play area vision transformed into a stunning treehouse sanctuary. Priced at $325,000, this remarkable creation boasts a pirate ship and an exciting zipline. Meticulously designed by professional engineers, the treehouse prioritizes safety and the health of the trees. Its multi-tiered layout offers cozy lofts perfect for family bonding and unforgettable gatherings, making it an enduring family attraction filled with wonder and creativity.
title: US grandpa's $100K treehouse becomes $325K backyard castle
